text: In fact, delaying debt repayment not only does not help to truly resolve the debt risk of local governments, but in most cases, it has planted a more powerful time bomb. text: Two years ago, the government of Runagia increased by 20 percent the government-provided pensions paid to Runagians over 65. text: Sedimentary rock hardens within the earth' s crust as layers of matter accumulate and the pressure of the layers above converts the layers below into rock. A layer of sedimentary rock takes millions of years to harden.

text: The media now devote more coverage to crime than they did ten years ago. text: On the whole, the GDP of the national economy is positively correlated with happiness. The more per capita income, the happier people are. text: Editorialist: In all cultures, it is almost universally accepted that one has a moral duty to prevent members of one' s family from being harmed. takes for granted that the parents mentioned in the example are not mistaken about their child's innocence
